title: VOA: AI-backed autonomous robots monitor construction progress
summary: “The construction industry is finding new uses for Artificial Intelligence . In a multi-story building project in the northwestern U.S. city of Seattle, autonomous robots are tasked with documenting progress and detecting potential hazards ”
